text: “I do not quite understand you.” “Oh, yes you do, I think. I think you do. Come, come, Lady Dedlock, we must not fence and parry now. You know you like this girl.” “Well, sir?” “And you know—and I know—that you have not sent her away for the reasons you have assigned, but for the purpose of separating her as much as possible from—excuse my mentioning it as a matter of business—any reproach and exposure that impend over yourself.” “Well, sir?” “Well, Lady Dedlock,” returns the lawyer, crossing his legs and nursing the uppermost knee. “I object to that.
